AC2 code reading: scripts/sound-set.mjs matches spec.md AC2 line by line. Both binaries are checked once, before target preparation. The ffmpeg argv equals the AC2 argv, token by token and in order. Per entry, the wrapper checks both targets, removes both, runs earshot, prints the Ogg line, runs ffmpeg, and prints the MP3 line. The three failure lines and their exit codes match AC2. Both spawnSync calls pass an argv array and set no shell option.

Live wrapper run (no render into sounds/). The setup used a temp root, the real ffmpeg 8.0.1-3ubuntu2 on PATH, and a stand-in earshot that copies the committed Ogg. `node scripts/sound-set.mjs chibi` exited 0 with empty stderr. It printed 15 lines in the AC2 order, ending `sound-set: 7 sounds -> sounds/chibi`. It wrote 14 files, and all 7 MP3 files equal the committed files byte for byte. The temp root was removed afterwards.

Live negative control: the same run with `FFMPEG_BIN=/nonexistent/ffmpeg` exited 1 with `sound-set: ffmpeg not found at /nonexistent/ffmpeg; install ffmpeg`, empty stdout, and no output folder. So the binary check stops the run before any file is written.

AC3: `sounds/chibi` holds 7 .ogg files and 7 .mp3 files. My own byte math applied the six header steps to each MP3. Byte 0 is 0xFF, and the sync bits hold. The version is MPEG1 and the layer is III. The bitrate index is 1 to 14, and the sample-rate index is 1 (48000 Hz).

AC3 frames: each MP3 file walks as whole 288-byte frames from byte 0 to the end. The frames match 96 kbps at 48 kHz with no padding. No ID3 tag and no Xing tag exist. ffmpeg decodes all seven files with no error.

README: sounds/README.md matches the files. Its 14 sizes equal the file sizes, with an Ogg total of 90,468 bytes and an MP3 total of 71,136 bytes. Its 14 durations equal the ffprobe format.duration rounded to 3 decimals, and each MP3 duration equals the frame count times 0.024 s. It records earshot 1.0.0 at 7a7f7c5c70d4a763a1eca4b3666af7c77e313f97 and `ffmpeg version 8.0.1-3ubuntu2`, which equals `ffmpeg -version` on this host.
